title: BankAccount
prompt: Implement `BankAccount` exactly as described — owner validation, the two exception types, and the untouched-balance rule on every rejection.

tests.name: basics
tests.hint: The happy path: constructor, deposit, withdraw, all reflected in Balance.

tests.name: invariants
tests.hint: Zero/negative deposits, over-withdrawal, negative withdrawal, blank owner — and the balance must not move.
